approach: Write docs/design/jev-code-health.md from the base, starting with an 'Existing code' survey (jev.rs client, request_body, FakeJev; live_jev_answers_both_question_kinds; labeled.rs and score-jev). Then specify five typed questions, batching and cost, the shadow period and evidence scoring, fit with assumed deterministic measures, Hestia and the scope guard, and a build plan J1 to J5, each marked reuse/extend/new and sized for one producer run. Append D131 (proposed) to decisions.md, add a CHANGELOG entry, and leave decision-links.toml alone unless the new entry uses supersede/amend wording.

decisions.choice: Survey existing code first and mark every build item reuse, extend or new against it
decisions.reason: The rejected attempt rebuilt a client, fake and scorer; jev.rs (request_body, FakeJev, retry via gh.rs) and labeled.rs (score-jev, Brier, time split, MIN_TEST_CASES) already exist.

rejected.option: A new code-health client or scorer
rejected.why: Duplicates working, tested code; what the last attempt got rejected for.

decisions.choice: Batch all questions about one landing into one request_body call (questions is a BTreeMap, so several fit)
decisions.reason: One call per landing keeps cost near the per-call range of $0.000012 to about $0.00002 (defaults-loop.md lines 259 and 667); call counts are estimates.

rejected.why: Multiplies calls about five-fold for no gain.

decisions.choice: Append D131 at the end of decisions.md using D129/D130 format, status proposed, avoiding the words superseded/amended
decisions.reason: Appending shifts no existing line, so decision-links.toml (keyed by line numbers) stays valid and is not touched; D130 already says 5p65 and zc0v are not in the snapshot.

rejected.why: Not needed; the brief allows it only if required.

decisions.choice: Mark deterministic measures from 5p65 as assumed, and mark all thresholds and counts as estimates
decisions.reason: That request is not in the repo; the evidence rule requires labeling.

decisions.choice: Shadow only: answers are recorded, never gating; exit rule needs a minimum count of scored cases and skill over a plain deterministic reference, reusing MIN_TEST_CASES logic
decisions.reason: jev.rs header says Jev only runs in shadow; labeled.rs already refuses a verdict without enough cases.

rejected.option: Let findings gate landing from day one
rejected.why: Contradicts shadow-only and D127 non-gating stance.

files.purpose: The design: Existing code, reuse/extend/new build plan J1-J5, batching and cost, five questions, shadow period and evidence scoring, fit, risks.
Append D131, proposed, with alternatives, tradeoff, reversal cost and provenance.
Add an entry under the Unreleased Added heading.
Only if D131 text uses supersede/amend wording the parse finds; the plan avoids that, so expect no change.

steps: Read the top of CHANGELOG.md, the end of decisions.md, hestia.md, scope-guard.md, and the record kinds labeled.rs reads (read_inputs).
Write docs/design/jev-code-health.md: purpose and audience, Existing code survey with paths and purposes.
Add the build plan J1-J5 table with reuse/extend/new, files, and a test or demonstration each, every job sized for one producer run (J3 and J4 included).
Write batching and cost per landing with the cited range and estimate labels.
Write the five questions with state, options, criteria, numeric threshold, effect.
Write shadow period, exit rule, evidence scoring and how it feeds labeled.rs score-jev.
Write fit with deterministic measures (5p65 assumed), Hestia (npr5) and the scope guard; add risks and open questions.
Append D131 (proposed) to docs/decisions.md and add the CHANGELOG entry.
Run cargo test --locked; touch decision-links.toml only if a test requires it.

risks.risk: Doc cites files or functions that do not exist
risks.mitigation: Producer reads jev.rs, labeled.rs, hestia.md, scope-guard.md before writing and cites only seen names.

risks.risk: Appending to decisions.md or the new text trips format, links or banned-word tests
risks.mitigation: Copy the D129/D130 format, avoid supersede/amend words, no email-like text, run cargo test --locked.
Label every threshold, count and cost total as an estimate; cite only the per-call range.

risks.risk: Build jobs too large for one run
risks.mitigation: Each of J1-J5 limited to one module with named files and one test.

demonstrations.method: Read the doc's 'Existing code' section and check each listed path exists.
demonstrations.observes: All paths listed; the section names request_body, FakeJev, live_jev_answers_both_question_kinds and score-jev with purposes.

demonstrations.method: Read the build-plan table: each item J1..J5 has reuse/extend/new and the only 'new' items are questions, state builders, thresholds, shadow records, evidence scoring.
demonstrations.observes: Only the four deliverable files changed; the doc's table has no new client, fake or scorer row.

demonstrations.method: Read the batching and cost section for the request_body citation, the range, the defaults-loop.md citation and 'estimate' labels.
demonstrations.observes: Text cites jev.rs request_body, $0.000012 to about $0.00002, defaults-loop.md, per-landing batched cost marked estimate.

demonstrations.method: Read the questions section: five questions each with state, options, criteria, numeric threshold, effect.
demonstrations.observes: One-thing-or-several, added coupling, module placement, god-object drift, duplicated logic each have all five fields with a number and an effect from {status finding, structural-pass request via 5p65, nothing}.

demonstrations.method: Read the shadow section for period, exit rule, evidence measures from landing records, and the feed into labeled.rs.
demonstrations.observes: Defines shadow period and exit rule, flagged-file break/churn and split-lands-reduces-churn measures, and how rows become labeled-set input for score_jev.
Sections on deterministic measures (5p65 marked assumed), Hestia (npr5, hestia.md) and scope guard (scope-guard.md, D127).

Only docs/design/jev-code-health.md, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md (and decision-links.toml only if needed) changed; D131 is marked proposed with alternatives; each build job states one-producer-run size, files and test.

demonstrations.method: Run the full test suite, which includes decisions format, decision-links and boundary/policy tests.
demonstrations.fails_without: A malformed D131 entry, a shifted decision-link line, or a banned word or email-like text in the new files would fail the decisions-format, links or policy tests.

open_questions: Exact name and shape of landing records the evidence measures read from; the doc should name what exists after reading records code, or mark it assumed.
Whether the next free decision number is D131 (last seen D130 at file end).
Which Unreleased subsection in CHANGELOG.md is first; the producer should read the top of the file.
